items.headline: Energy One grows as ETRM consolidation accelerates
items.summary: Energy One reported FY2026 recurring revenue up sharply as larger trading platform rollouts reached go-live, while commentators flagged Mitsubishi Electric's acquisition of PCI Energy Solutions as a sign of continued ETRM/CTRM vendor consolidation.

items.headline: BRAC Bank digitises trade finance with Finastra, Conpend
items.summary: Bangladesh's BRAC Bank went live on Finastra's Trade Innovation and Corporate Channels alongside Conpend's Trade AI, letting corporate clients initiate, approve and track trade transactions on one digital channel.

items.headline: REMIT II reporting duties take effect this spring
items.summary: New REMIT II rules applying from 29 April 2026 introduce three reporting tiers, cut the deadline for bilateral OTC contract reports to 10 working days, and extend scope to hydrogen, storage and algorithmic trading, with exposure reporting above 600 GWh planned from Q1 2027.

items.headline: Shanghai exchange adds new container freight benchmarks
items.summary: The Shanghai Shipping Exchange officially launched seven additional Shanghai Containerized Freight Index benchmarks covering major trade lanes and rolled out a revised 2026 index-linked container contract template for carriers and cargo owners.
